meta_description: Perfect Garden Care in Southampton offers professional garden maintenance, landscaping, and seasonal care. Local gardeners serving Holbury and surrounding areas.
hero_eyebrow: Local Southampton Gardeners — Reliable Year-Round Care
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to stunning outdoor spaces, we handle the hard work so you can enjoy your garden.
services_subhead: Whether you need regular maintenance, a complete redesign, or seasonal tidying, we've got your garden covered.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly cuts, edging, and tidying. We keep your lawn pristine and borders weed-free throughout the year, whatever the season throws at you.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Pruning
services.desc: Professional shaping and cutting of hedges, shrubs, and trees. Safe removal of overgrown branches and proper disposal of all waste.

services.title: Patio & Decking Cleaning
services.desc: Deep clean patios, decking, and driveways using specialist equipment. Removes moss, algae, and years of grime to restore your outdoor space.

services.title: Garden Clearance
services.desc: Complete removal of overgrown vegetation, dead trees, and garden waste. We leave your garden ready for a fresh start, with all rubbish responsibly disposed of.

services.title: Landscaping & Design
services.desc: Bespoke garden designs and installation of new beds, borders, and planting schemes. Transform a dull space into a garden you'll actually want to spend time in.

services.title: Seasonal Services
services.desc: Spring preparation, summer feeding and watering, autumn leaf clearance, and winter protection for your plants. Year-round care tailored to what your garden needs.

about_pullquote: A well-kept garden shouldn't feel like a burden — it should feel like a sanctuary.
about_para_1: Perfect Garden Care was founded over a decade ago because we saw too many gardens in Southampton left neglected or handled by unreliable contractors. We started with a simple idea: turn up on time, do the work properly, and leave customers genuinely satisfied. That commitment has grown us from a one-person operation to a respected team handling everything from basic maintenance to full garden redesigns.
about_para_2: Our customers choose us because we listen, we show up when we say we will, and we take pride in every job — whether it's a quick tidy or a complete overhaul. We've built our reputation through word-of-mouth recommendations across Holbury and beyond, and we still treat every garden like it matters.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Been using Perfect Garden Care for three years now. They come every fortnight without fail, and my garden looks immaculate. Fair prices and genuinely nice blokes. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had a nightmare jungle of a garden that'd been left to go wild. They cleared it completely in two days and gave me a quote for redesigning it. Professional, efficient, and didn't rip me off. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Sarah K.

reviews.text: Called them for emergency patio cleaning before a family gathering and they squeezed me in the next day. Patio looks brand new. Will definitely use them again for regular maintenance.
reviews.author: James P.
